case_for: Went to the borrower first: multi-district channel-partner network and thousands of farmers assessed before scaling lending (R2).
Distribution network that travels beyond the founders and compounds (R6, R4).
case_against: No default/NPA data in the file - the deciding metric is missing (R3).
Credit-risk depth not yet on the team (R1, S3).
Lending is capital-hungry and seasonal; channel-partner and regulatory dependence (R5, R4).
Sector label stretch: rural lending more than fintech (G3).
call_questions: Show us repayment and default data by cohort and by crop season.
Who holds the credit risk on each loan - you, a lending partner, or the channel partner?
Who will own credit risk on the team, and when do you hire them?
What happens to collections in a failed monsoon year?
We worry you're a distribution business that hasn't yet learned credit - convince us otherwise, with a specific loss you took and what you changed.
what_would_change_our_view: Cohort repayment data through at least one crop cycle and a named owner of credit risk on the team.
